reference_product: OnRobot RG6 with standard EPDM fingertips

step_measurement.use: Measuring instrument only: read locally with OpenCASCADE (part bounding boxes, sections, cylinder axes). No STEP file, tessellation, surface, outline trace or derived mesh is in this repository; the shapes are independent extrusions, discs and boxes sized from the readings.
step_measurement.pose_handling: The STEP is saved at one intermediate opening with the body tilted 0.9 deg on the bracket; the tilt was removed and the joint zero follows the datasheet stroke, not the saved pose.

rights_review: Official public datasheets, product photography and the product-page STEP were used. The onrobot.com terms of use (read 2026-10-10) grant a personal, non-commercial, revocable licence to the site and its content and prohibit copying or redistributing it; they state no CAD-specific terms, and the STEP header carries no notice. As with the datasheets, only facts (dimensions) are taken; no OEM file, image, drawing, CAD, mesh, logo or texture is redistributed.

measured_dimensions_mm.mount: robot-side Quick Changer tool face = robot flange + 13.6 mm (QC datasheet v2.0); the STEP contains the robot-side QC (16.1 mm overall)
measured_dimensions_mm.datasheet_length_datum: top of the robot-side QC = mount + 2.5 mm; open 208.3 / closed 262.6 / housing 151.7 mm against the sheet 208 / 262 / 152

model.joint_zero: fully open: datasheet stroke between the bare fingers
model.upper_limit: 1.2352 rad, where the standard pads meet (travel between pads 150 mm)
model.tcp: centre of the pads where they meet, 251.99 mm from mount (photo-based draft: 272.5 mm); the pads drop up to 54.4 mm towards the mount when open
model.collision: per-link boxes and cylinders enclosing each link visual to 1 um, no exceptions

estimates: Fillets, chamfers and the small-radius shapes of the housing, hubs and cover plates are simplified
The inner link slot starts at 64 mm (STEP: 70.0 mm) so the simplified carrier clears it when the pads meet
Cover plates ride on the outer link without the inner rib; the real plates are pinned to the carrier and slide on the outer link
The housing is a shell with an open head channel; a core fills it only below the link sweep (to z 103.5 mm)
Quick Changer: tool-side spigot and blue ring only; latch, contacts and mating fit are not modelled
Link insets, switch internals, internal screws and pins are omitted; pin/boss overlaps are display joints, not clearances
Mass and inertia are not modelled
excluded: Vendor CAD, its tessellation or any derived mesh
Functional safety switch, Quick Changer latch, cable and dynamics
known_mismatches: The fixed TCP equals the pad centre only where the pads meet; the pads swing towards the mount as the gripper opens
With the standard pads the upper limit stops before the bare fingers meet; bare-finger closing (no fingertips) is not modelled
The housing bottom sits 0.1 mm into the bracket base (fixed joint)
revision: 2026-10-11: pivots, housing, bracket, links, carriers, pads and cover plates re-sized from the STEP measurements. Pivots and housing move 20.0 mm towards the mount; the TCP moves from 272.5 to 251.99 mm.
legacy_note: The earlier joint origins came from these public ROS descriptions; their heights did not match the measured product above the Quick Changer tool face. Only the joint graph, names, mimic rules and mesh paths are kept.
